cases.name: negative control: installed lifecycle keeps the unusable prompt after original lease expiry
whole source is blocked; incremental owner change preserves all metadata and rejects reapplication
NEED_SERVICE: failed, cancelled, unconfirmed-success and expired single inputs retain only exact user text
NEED_SERVICE: active prepared and active dispatched input are not prematurely minimized
NEED_SERVICE: minimized input cannot be redispatched, re-prepared or exposed to another account
NEED_SERVICE: account/conversation holds and closure restrictions retain the original snapshot
NEED_SERVICE: corrupt or unknown snapshot is retained instead of silently losing its context
NEED_SERVICE: real row or retention lock contention preserves input until the lock is released

WORKER_CAPABILITY: active prepared and active dispatched input are not prematurely minimized
WORKER_CAPABILITY: minimized input cannot be redispatched, re-prepared or exposed to another account
WORKER_CAPABILITY: account/conversation holds and closure restrictions retain the original snapshot
WORKER_CAPABILITY: corrupt or unknown snapshot is retained instead of silently losing its context
WORKER_CAPABILITY: real row or retention lock contention preserves input until the lock is released
the sweep shares one bounded 100-row budget and canonical copies have priority over old single inputs
a caller-supplied future time cannot minimize an active prepared input
guarded code rollback retains minimized data, original markers and refusal of another dispatch

limits: Exact captured SQL owners with existing reduced context/closure fixture; not the complete hosted schema or policy execution.
No live provider, Android, final user-text retention period or public export/closure acceptance.
Native lock checks execute only when explicitly enabled with the isolated PostgreSQL runtime.
